name: operand-test-0e6612016b/operand_int_and_default_default-v.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Supports [`required-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#required-params), [`defaultable-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#defaultable-params), [`included-record-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#included-record-param) and [`rest-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#rest-param) in the signature
### Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
reason: The assertion requires launching main with command-line operand "1", converting it to int, and supplying the omitted string parameter's default so that Riyafa is printed. Function signatures and ordinary omitted default arguments are supported, but command-line operand binding and conversion for main are not covered by subset10.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line operand binding/conversion and defaultable main parameter handling
test_design_notes: The @args annotation makes CLI entry-point behavior essential; there is no ordinary source-level call to main. io:println is output instrumentation.
